notes:
Importing is simpler, and several screens now match the rest of the app.

**Import goes straight to the file picker.** The choice between browsing inside Obbligato and browsing elsewhere is gone — the system picker is now used every time. It is the only one that can reach Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, since files stored there do not exist on the tablet itself.

**Obbligato now appears in the Share menu of other apps.** If you are already in Drive or Dropbox looking at a PDF, you can send it straight to Obbligato without opening the picker at all. Several at once works too.

**Buttons in the ink layers window, the folder browser and the tag windows now match the rest of the app.** These were built in code and had been missed by earlier restyling.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
